channel.title: Knowledge Recorder Updates
channel.description: Signed macOS updates for Knowledge Recorder.

item.description:
## Knowledge Recorder 1.1.60
### macOS
- Source code and release delivery now live under the BIK GmbH GitHub organization. - The Sparkle feed points directly to the BIK-owned public release repository. - Existing 1.1.59 installations remain update-compatible through GitHub's repository redirects.
### Windows
- Source code and release delivery now live under the BIK GmbH GitHub organization. - The in-app updater points directly to the BIK-owned public release repository. - Existing 1.1.59 installations remain update-compatible through GitHub's repository redirects.
### SHA256
- `DesktopRecorder-macOS.dmg`: `b57219e92c248e0c2a40de1849f9f08e79e10f3d3abd7fdd3749c8a154b6f584` - `DesktopRecorder.exe`: `25b1694e60a7f6634a151264c2d122e85c555ae2b74556d56736680eb3d3549a` - `DesktopRecorder-Setup.exe`: `d4d42fe1f46aa2d2c804737aed5462fa4c30ca5b8368f18924a7c418aa8a0418`

## Knowledge Recorder 1.1.59
### macOS
- The dictation history storage card now opens saved dictations and audio files directly in Finder. - The storage folder is created automatically when it does not exist yet.
### Windows
- The dictation history storage card now opens saved dictations and audio files directly in File Explorer. - The storage folder is created automatically when it does not exist yet.
### SHA256
- `DesktopRecorder-macOS.dmg`: `3d89aee65da7560dbbb43d11264d73ce8c9671c0b1de4963849fc4b0b1ddae61` - `DesktopRecorder.exe`: `4b3c5d2ad9bb4b83067bed9761b3978df619563f7fafc990453521fa81bf15c0` - `DesktopRecorder-Setup.exe`: `4cd2d6857eee5089b71e111a780f2e0360de41242fc1f087c7e6699ec365c5bd`

## Knowledge Recorder 1.1.58
### macOS
- Dictation history rows now remain visually still when the pointer moves over their text. - Hover and pressed feedback is limited to the individual actions: copy, playback, pin, delete, and details.
### Windows
- Dictation history rows no longer highlight as a whole. - The individual action buttons retain their direct hover and pressed feedback.
